pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Grid pattern: one tab stop, roving focus between cells and headers, arrow-key navigation, widgets inside cells reached with Enter or F2.

row (aria-rowindex; aria-selected with row selection; aria-level, aria-expanded, aria-setsize, aria-posinset in treegrids; aria-busy for rows still loading)
columnheader (aria-colindex, aria-sort, aria-colspan for groups, aria-rowspan for spanning leaves, aria-expanded for collapsible groups)
gridcell (aria-colindex, aria-selected with cell ranges, aria-rowspan / aria-colspan for spans and full-width or detail rows)

focus: One tab stop on the focused cell or header (initially the first header). The focused row and column stay rendered while scrolled away, so focus is never lost to virtualization.
notes: Sort changes, column moves and resizes, group toggles, loading, selection counts, writes, undo, row moves, pins, exports, and filter results are announced through the shared live region.
Pinned columns are sticky cells in DOM order, so reading order matches the visual order in both directions.

Every pointer gesture has a keyboard or menu path (WCAG 2.5.7): Alt+arrows resize columns and rows, Ctrl+Shift+arrows move rows, the pill buttons edit the group and pivot panels, the cell menu sends rows to drop zones, Ctrl+D / Ctrl+R fill; file drop needs a file input in the page.
Formula error cells read their meaning after the code; the formula editor is a combobox with suggestions and an argument hint in its description.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack) is pending.
Exported PDFs are not tagged (no PDF/UA); the grid, CSV, Excel, and print keep the table structure.
